extracted.intended_audience: PR students and early-career public relations professionals (PRSSA members)
extracted.subtask_short: pr ethics for students and professionals
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational ethics guidance for PR students and practitioners, describing professional values and a coded pledge members should follow. Includes the PRSSA pledge and direction to the PRSA Code of Ethics and Professional Standards Advisories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uphold highest ethical standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Successful public relations hinges on the ethics of its practitioners. As a future professional, it is essential that you uphold the highest ethical standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRSSA promotes ethical practice by asking members to adhere to the PRSSA Code of Ethics and Conduct and encourages all Chapters to have members sign the pledge upon joining the organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: We serve the public interest by acting as responsible advocates for those we represent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We provide a voice in the marketplace of ideas, facts and viewpoints to aid informed public debate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honesty
rubrics_metrics.description: We adhere to the highest standards of accuracy and truth in advancing the interests of those we represent and in communicating with the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: We acquire and responsibly use specialized knowledge and experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We advance the profession through continued professional development, research and education. We build mutual understanding, credibility and relationships among a wide array of institutions and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide objective counsel to those we represent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We are accountable for our actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loyalty
rubrics_metrics.description: We are faithful to those we represent, while honoring our obligation to serve the public interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: We deal fairly with clients, employers, competitors, peers, vendors, the media and the general public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We respect all opinions and support the right of free expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRSSA Code of Ethics and Conduct (member pledge)
rubrics_metrics.description: I pledge to conduct myself professionally, with truth, accuracy, fairness and responsibility to the public, fellow members and to the Society; to improve my individual competence and advance the knowledge and proficiency of the field of public relations; and to adhere to the articles of the Member Code of Ethics and Conduct by the PRSSA International Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members are asked to sign the pledge; the pledge signals acceptance of consequences for misconduct, up to and including membership revocation, and that violation may further bar PRSA membership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Chapters should require/encourage pledge signing
rubrics_metrics.description: PRSSA encourages all Chapters to have members sign the pledge upon joining the organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a recommended chapter-level practice to promote adherence to the Code of Ethics and Conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the PRSA Code of Ethics and consult advisories
rubrics_metrics.description: PRSSA models its ethics guidelines after those of its parent organization, PRSA. The PRSA Code of Ethics was created to help members navigate ethical principles and applications, and is widely regarded as the industry standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For further reference, see the PRSA Code of Ethics Pledge. For information about specific ethical dilemmas and issues, view the PRSA Professional Standards Advisories.
